senses.gloss: (b. h.) to blind; to cause perversion of judgment.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 144:10">Sifré Deut. 144</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:19">Deut. XVI, 19</cite>) <he>כי השוחד יְעַוֵּר שאומר על וכ׳</he> ‘bribe blindeth’, that means, that (in old age) he will declare unclean what is clean &c.; Yalk. ib. 907; <cite ref="Ketubot 105a:15">Keth. 105ᵃ</cite> (v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:9">Peah VIII, 9</cite>); Mekh. Mishp., s. 20 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:8">Ex. XXIII, 8</cite>) <he>יעור עיני חכמים בתורה</he> blinds the judgment of scholars of the Law.

senses.gloss: to be blinded. Tanḥ. Aḥăré 1 נִתְעַוִּרוּ עיניו his eyes were put out.
